name: Dead hang
cue: Hang with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.

name: Set your shoulders
cue: Pull your shoulder blades down and back to begin.

name: Pull upward
cue: Bring your chest toward the bar without swinging.

name: Clear the bar
cue: Pull until your chin clears the bar, keeping your shoulders down.

name: Lower with control
cue: Lower smoothly along the same path.

name: Return to the hang
cue: Continue to full arm extension without bouncing.
